comments.author: earwaxking
comments.body_html:
No worries. What level are your hideout modules. Some around level 1 do not require any FIR status.

A few things to determine if its this or some other mod conflict, as I’m not able to reproduce the issue:

  1. Check https://tarkov.dev/hideout, this mod “should” make the FIR status match what it says there.
  2. Does the FIR status come back after removing this mod?
  3. What other mods excluding SVM are installed?

If your seeing high level upgrades not require FIR or its not matching TarkovDev then something is wrong… however, this mod should not be touching anything outside the config items.

If your still having issues, feel free to open an issue on the Github page.
